$comment: Temporary high/critical advisory allowlist read by the CI audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
An entry is ONLY justified when a fix exists but is currently un-installable under .npmrc
min-release-age=7 (the patched version is published but <7 days old). Each entry MUST be
converted to an npm `overrides` pin and DELETED from this file once its fix ages past
min-release-age (see `ageInOn`). The gate FAILS on ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here,
so the allowlist never weakens the gate for un-triaged findings. Reviewed by the Architect.
STATUS 2026-08-07: empty. The two brace-expansion entries (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg,
GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895) aged in on 2026-08-06 and are now pinned via nested `overrides` in
package.json: the 1.x path (minimatch@3.1.5) -> brace-expansion 1.1.18, the 5.x path
(minimatch@10.2.5) -> brace-expansion 5.0.9 -- verified distinct per `npm ls brace-expansion
--all` (5.0.x is incompatible with the 1.x consumer, see the removed entries' `reason`).
js-yaml (GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj) is separately resolved by raising its `overrides` pin to
^5.2.1. npm audit reports 0 high/critical. The committed lockfile pins all three, so
`npm ci`/`npm install` install them cleanly while .npmrc keeps min-release-age=7 for all
other (future) dependency resolution.
braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) removed 2026-10-23: resolved upstream (no longer in npm audit).
follow-redirects (GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p) removed 2026-11-02: 1.16.2 aged past min-release-age, now pinned via `overrides`.
EXPIRY IS ENFORCED by scripts/audit-gate.mjs: an entry whose `expires` (YYYY-MM-DD) is in the past stops allowlisting and
the advisory blocks (`EXPIRED allowlist entry ...`). An entry with no `expires` is INVALID and blocks, unless it is explicitly
`noPatch: true` with a `reviewDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) that is not yet past. Renewal needs Architect review.

allow.reason: Two transitive 3.x copies under @coinbase/cdp-sdk (^3.25.76) and @reown/appkit-wallet (3.22.4, exact) have no patched 3.x release; moving them to zod 4 is a breaking major for those packages. Reachability: both validate wallet/SDK messages with fixed-shape schemas, not attacker-sized collections; the root app copy is 4.6.6. Re-check weekly for a 3.x patch or upstream bumps of cdp-sdk/appkit; delete on first fix.
